key_insight: A robotic, AI-guided cold gas-dynamic spraying workflow can reclaim steel marine propellers and add long-life anti-corrosion protection without thermal distortion.
engineering_relevance: The concept enables on-site repair of large propellers with automated defect mapping, coating, and finish grinding, reducing downtime and extending service life in harsh marine environments.
method: 6-axis robot with AI computer vision scans and maps blade defects in 3D
Automatic tool changer switches between abrasive prep, supersonic CGDS coating, and force-controlled finish grinding
Adaptive control loop tunes process steps for complex propeller geometry and surface quality
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an estimated 4–5× increase in protective coating lifespan and evaluates economic feasibility for on-site supertanker repair.
watch_item: Industrial adoption will depend on reliable vision/force calibration and robust process control on large, highly curved, and variable-condition propeller surfaces.
paper_title: Automated Complex for the Reclamation and Anti-Corrosion Protection of Steel Marine Propellers via Supersonic Cold Gas-Dynamic Spraying Utilizing AI-Driven Control
